summary: All14 native portraits and contact explicitly inspected at final C300. No new broad facial collapse. Validation/new heldouts/fixed unseen do not show convincing clerical collar generalization. No production approval.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
